title: Kicked Up German Noodle Casserole
description: A hearty German-inspired noodle casserole with a kick. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook German egg noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef and German sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking up meat with a spoon as it cooks.
Add onion to the skillet and cook until softened. Stir in ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked noodles, meat mixture, and shredded cheddar cheese. Stir until well combined.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
